item.title: 14 Afghans released from Azerbaijani prisons
item.description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) says 14 Afghans have been released from prisons in Azerbaijan through the efforts of the Afghan embassy in Baku.

item.title: MoI hands over new, fully equipped vehicles to traffic police
item.description: The Ministry of Interior (MoI) on Saturday distributed new vehicles to personnel of the General Directorate of Traffic Police, saying the vehicles are equipped with special colors, markings and modern equipment.

item.title: Ghor residents complain about shortages of safe drinking water
item.description: Some residents of Allah Yar district in western Ghor province are complaining about the lack of access to clean drinking water, while officials say efforts are underway to tackle the problem.

item.title: Afghanistan begin T20 WC campaign against New Zealand today
item.description: Afghanistan and New Zealand are set to face each other today (Sunday) in their opening group-stage match of the 2026 ICC Men’s T20 World Cup at the MA Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai.

item.title: $2m project to bring electricity to 21 Badghis villages
item.description: The power utility in western Badghis province says imported electricity from Turkmenistan, costing two million dollars, will be extended to 21 villages in Sang-i-Atash district within the next five months.

item.title: Iran prepared for both diplomacy, war: Araghchi
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi has described negotiations with the United States in Muscat, the capital of Oman, as “a good start.”

item.title: Basharat brothers shine with victories in UFC bouts
item.description: Afghan mixed martial arts fighters Javed Basharat and Farid Basharat claimed impressive victories against opponents from Mexico and Brazil on Sunday.

item.title: 15 killed, 3 injured in Badakhshan traffic accident
item.description: At least 15 people, including women and children, have been killed and three others injured in a traffic accident in northeastern Badakhshan province, an official said on Sunday.

item.title: Sugar, cooking oil, gold prices down in Kabul
item.description: The prices of sugar, cooking oil and gold declined, while Pakistani rice increased in the outgoing week in Kabul, market sources said on Sunday.
